turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not too bad.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My knees are shot from years of football. Swimming or the rowing machine?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Both are gentle on the knees. Swimming is zero impact, while rowing builds more strength but does bend the knees a lot. How do your knees feel when you squat?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, can you wait? My friend is talking to me. Keep quiet until I come back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, I'll wait.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Rosa, what time is it?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's almost seven.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm here if you need a hand with the boxes.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Great, grab the heavy one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Be honest, does this shirt look okay on me?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The color's great but it's kind of big in the shoulders.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, I thought so too. Should I try a smaller size?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Definitely. And maybe that green one next to it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The green? I never wear green.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: That's exactly why you should try it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, back. Thanks for being patient.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. So, the pool or the rower?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Squatting hurts, so swimming.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then swimming it is. Front crawl or backstroke are kinder than breaststroke, which twists the knees.
